subject.title: fix(codex-native): interrupt live Codex subagent thread on tasks cancel

question: Should live child-thread interruption be added to the documented registered task-runtime/plugin capability, rather than introducing a separate `globalThis` bridge between core and the Codex extension?
rationale: The repair needs a durable cross-boundary API direction; automation should not establish a new undocumented plugin contract.

options.title: Extend the existing runtime seam
options.body: Add a narrow documented live-cancel capability to the existing registered task-runtime or injected plugin surface and implement Codex interruption behind it.

options.title: Approve a separate bridge
options.body: Explicitly accept a distinct core-to-Codex cancellation bridge and define its lifecycle, reload, and compatibility contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Extend the existing runtime seam
recommendation.body: Add a narrow documented live-cancel capability to the existing registered task-runtime or injected plugin surface and implement Codex interruption behind it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Codex app-server reliability work makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the ownership-boundary decision.
